answer: Anchor each epoch's challenge to an unpredictable randomness beacon, then have a rotating jury grade the written answer for genuine understanding. Seed words thread through a prompt nobody can precompute, so canned text fails on sight. A sybil can mass-produce identities but cannot mass-produce distinct coherent reasoning; flood the system and every near-duplicate stands out like a violet in gravel. Judgment of real work, not headcount, gates reward.
